notes.title: DEADSIM ARCADE Update // OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/89fc7a749a2c848e661d44bca14e1dad0a1cc64a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Insert your coins, hit continue, and jump on into another FREE KILLRUN update, DEADSIM ARCADE! Here’s what to expect.[/h2]

[h3][b]// DEADSIM ARCADE Map Pack[/b][/h3]
We’ve added 15 more maps! With the varying difficulty throughout, the [b]DEADSIM Map Pack[/b] introduces new ways to shave off those crucial seconds when you need them most with the new [b]INFINITE Power Up[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/2cb3854cc75f88e25057fdd6a1c5474316594abd.png[/img]

Become the beast you were meant to be with the new [b]INIFINITE Power Up[/b]. This new Power Up grants [b]100% hip fire accuracy[/b],[b] unlimited ammo[/b] and [b]improved vision[/b], allowing you to decimate more bots and their friends with ease. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/3dd77ebd1e18d678e142325fc91535843205e552.jpg[/img]

[h3]
[b]// BRAMCO MODKIT[/b][/h3]
What would an Arcade be without the right equipment? We’ve added the BRAMCO MODKIT to give you your nostalgia fix, featuring a new Rifle, SMG, Sniper, Pistol & Melee all for [b]FREE[/b], for you to unlock. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/8d1ebaf4b698b95e14db0a68205f2187b009ff91.png[/img]

[h3]
[b]// Bounce Pad & Hot Drop Training[/b][/h3]
For new and returning players, head over to the Phan Tech Training Facility and learn how best to utilise bouncing and hot drops to your advantage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/7680cb8b2f536e927f1f51f1ef9ccece9509e019.jpg[/img]
[h3]
[b]// Quality of Life and Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]  Changed required star times on all maps across the board for increased accessibility for new players, allowing for an overall better experience when unlocking content in game. 
[*]  Fixed classified sniper sprint bug
[*]  Improved low FPS on training facility
[*]  Fixed sensitivity slider in training facility lag issue
[/list]

Thank you for the continued support and see you on the leaderboards!
[i]The KILLRUN Team[/i]

notes.title: DAWNBREAKER Update // Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/6218234890056dc221d5c8c551c9347e0c1a33b3.png[/img]
[h2]At the break of dawn. RUN. We’re excited to bring you KILLRUN’s first FREE update DAWNBREAKER! Heres whats in store.[/h2]

[h3]// New Ways To Learn[/h3]
We recognised that understanding the core fundamentals and 'feelback' of KILLRUN's movement and gunplay wasn't up to par for new players jumping into our speedrunning experience. Because of this, we've fleshed out and built on some of our original tutorials with an all new 'Phantech Training Facility'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/5f3d7c2143fd9cc547a046d150fa225dac8e42d2.png[/img]

The Phantech Training Facility now acts as our hub to really get to grips with, and improve, your movement and aim at your own pace. The training facility provides new video tutorials for our growing list of mechanics, including [b]STRAFE JUMPING[/b] & [b]SLIDE HOPPING[/b] alongside an all new aim trainer! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/9e63a4ee334f0c06412c3c1da41221a72236d98a.png[/img]

[h3]
// All Aim No Brain[/h3]
Aiming makes up an important part of cutting key seconds off your times as you traverse across KILLRUN's trials. With our all new aim trainer, players no longer need to worry about the stress of the clock and can set their mice to cruise control. Here, you can control how you learn on the fly with sensitivity options (Scoped, ADS and General), [b]Infinite Ammo[/b], [b]Stats in Progress[/b], [b]Diffculty[/b] (Easy/Medium/Hard) and the number of bots you'd like to spawn, from as little as 5, all the way up to your very own small robot army of 100' 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/8c247277a9ee4dd0d7a23f0cbab853bf5fcc0fe2.jpg[/img]

[h3]
// DAWNBREAKER Map Pack[/h3]
With this update comes 15 new maps of varying difficulty for you to battle up the leaderboards and earn your stars. More bounces, more bots, and more bravado. We can't wait to see how players use their ever expanding skill set to master these new trials. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/71afb768b4d0409f07e1f302ca179ebfbfc77a03.png[/img]

[h3]// Classified MODKIT[/h3]
Straight from the Phantech Lab comes a new set of 'Classified' weapons for each of our weapon archtypes. This pack includes a new Rifle, SMG, Sniper, Pistol & Melee with new and interesting ways to unlock them for [b]FREE[/b] in game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373486/e08e752465daae599d6de40d7287fb103ab296f8.png[/img]

[h3]
// Quality of Life and Bug Fixes[/h3]
With our continued support of KILLRUN we've made a few fixes and requested features:
[list]

[*] Fixed ironsight for Thompson SMG
[*] Added extra time punishment to using JUMPER load gadget with UI indicator 
[*] Changed resolution scaling method to add support for ultrawide monitors
[*] Added FOV slider up to 120
[/list]

Thank you for the continued support and see you on the leaderboards! 
[i]The KILLRUN Team [/i]
